translations.web: Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
translations.bsb: Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You—majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
translations.kjv: Who is like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
translations.asv: Who is like unto thee, O Jehovah, among the gods? Who is like thee, glorious in holiness, Fearful in praises, doing wonders?
